# Estimating Functions Source Code

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
This appendix collects the full source of `samplingestimate.r`, the shared file of estimating functions used throughout the book. In the HTML version, that listing is already shown inline (collapsed by default) at the point where each chapter first sources the file, so it is omitted here --- expand the "Show the shared estimating functions" block in any chapter to view it.
:::

::: {.content-visible unless-format="html"}
The R functions used throughout this book to compute point estimates, standard errors, and confidence intervals --- along with their `gt`-table formatting helpers --- are defined in a single shared file, `samplingestimate.r`, which every chapter sources. Its full source is listed below for reference.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat("```r\n")
cat(readLines("samplingestimate.r"), sep = "\n")
cat("\n```\n")
```
:::
